name: Freqtrade
description: Free and open-source crypto trading bot written in Python. It is designed to support all major exchanges and be controlled via Telegram or a WebUI.

options.label: Installation Directory
options.description: Absolute path where Freqtrade data and configuration will be stored.

options.label: WebUI Port
options.description: The port used to access the Freqtrade internal web interface.

options.label: Enable Dry-Run (Sandbox)
options.description: Keep this enabled to trade with simulated money safely. Disable for live trading.
